meta.title: fr-030 candytron
meta.author: farbrausch
meta.description: fr-030 candytron by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the release executable of fr-030 candytron, carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/candytron.v2m`). The same file is also at fr_public/genthree__data__josie.v2m in the local corpus. 120 BPM, 3:19, 25 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by +0.21 dB loudness and at most 0.81 @ 1000 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
